name: jalankan-tiket
description: The jalankan-tiket workflow for Claude Code. Plan a product with its owner, then let Claude work GitHub tickets autonomously through an implementer, a reviewer, a PR, CI and a merge. A second plugin, qa, tests web apps built by other teams.

plugins.name: tiket
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub-ticket workflow: set up a project, plan it through grilling, then run tickets through implementer and reviewer subagents, PR, CI and merge.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: QA for web apps built by other teams: a private QA workspace, a readiness audit, and black-box tests against staging, with bugs on Trello and reports in Google Docs.
